package.description: A free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 11 and 10

en-US.description: A free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 11 and 10
en-US.longDescription:
PecoFence organizes the Windows 11 and 10 desktop into glass fences. Group files and shortcuts
into fences, keep real folders on the desktop as live portals, combine related fences
into tabs, and bring everything above the current application with one shortcut.
Rules file new items automatically, layouts can be snapshotted and restored, and the
interface is available in eleven languages. The bundled pecofence-cli command lets scripts
and AI coding agents read and change fences, rules and settings. Native Rust
application; the Settings window uses the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime that ships
with Windows.
en-US.name: PecoFence
en-US.releaseNotes:
PecoFence 0.3.1 opens folders you drop onto a program in a fence with that program, and its installer now runs on Windows 10 2004 and later.
Highlights
- Drop folders onto a program to open them with it (#194, thanks to @lizt12). Drop one or more folders onto an application's shortcut in a fence, or onto a program file itself (a portable app's .exe, .com, .bat or .cmd), and the program starts with those folders, with the shortcut's saved arguments and start folder. The folders stay where they are and keep their fence, and the badge says Open with and the program's name. Files, files and folders together, and shortcuts that are not programs (documents, folders, broken or Store app links) go into the fence as before.
Fixes
- The installer runs on Windows 10 2004 and later (build 19041), as the Store edition does. Windows 10 21H2 and LTSC 2021 used to get "This program does not support the version of Windows your computer is running", although the portable ZIP ran there.
Downloads
- pecofence-v0.3.1-x64-setup.exe: installer, per user, no administrator rights needed.
- pecofence-v0.3.1-x64-portable.zip: portable; extract and run pecofence.exe.
- A .sha256 checksum for each.
Copies installed with the setup can update from Settings → About → Check for updates.
Full changelog: v0.3.0...v0.3.1

zh-CN.description: 免费开源的 Windows 11 和 10 桌面整理工具，Stardock Fences 的另一种选择
zh-CN.longDescription:
PecoFence 把 Windows 11 和 10 桌面整理成一个个玻璃栅栏：把文件和快捷方式分组收纳，把真实文件夹作为
门户放在桌面上，把相关栅栏合成标签页，再用一个快捷键把它们全部浮现在当前应用前面。规则可以
自动归类新文件，布局可以保存快照并恢复，界面提供十一种语言。附带的 pecofence-cli 命令让脚本和
AI 编程智能体可以读取和修改栅栏、规则与设置。Rust 编写的原生应用，设置窗口使用
Windows 自带的 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime。
zh-CN.name: PecoFence
